chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Allāh does not grant wisdom to a person except that some day He will save him from ruin with its help.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of wisdom (aql) according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes the instrumental nature of divine intellect (aql), asserting that it is never bestowed without purpose. This reflects the Shia epistemological view that aql is the primary faculty for discerning truth and avoiding spiritual ruin, serving as a divine safeguard that ultimately rescues the believer from destruction.
